name: Kirana (Grocery shop)

cost_items.name: Shelving and storage
cost_items.note: Basic wooden and metal shelving for a single-room shop, Nashik 2026 assumption

cost_items.name: Initial stock
cost_items.note: Stock value equals unit_scale (₹); replenished from revenue

cost_items.name: Shop fit-out (signage, counter)
cost_items.note: One-time fit-out for a 150 sq ft roadside shop, Nashik rural 2026 assumption

revenue.note: Average basket ₹800/customer/month; revenue = customers × ₹800; Nashik rural 2026 assumption

operating_cost.note: COGS ~65%, spoilage ~5%; fixed: rent (if any) and utilities ₹3000/month assumption

notes: Retail sector. Local mode: household demand limits sales. adoption_rate 60% of households shop at a kirana monthly. capacity_per_competitor 80 customers/month assumption.
